verdict.rationale: Browser Use's core interaction model is giving an agent a natural-language goal, for example `client.runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story")`, or tasks like "Fill in this job application with my resume and information." It can also be driven from AI assistants via its MCP server, and community users report hands-on success automating tasks. missing for 10: evidence of a no-code conversational interface for operating it outside of code/API or MCP clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
